what: Dot row below the photo slider — each dot has a thin 1px ring in a pale line color, and only the current slide’s dot fills with a dark color, going straight clockwise from 12 o’clock over 5 seconds and then staying filled. When the slide changes and another dot becomes current, that dot fills again from the start — a slider dot that shows the time left until the next slide

options.--fx-dur: Time for the ring to fill completely (via style), default 5s — match the slide interval
options.--fx-size · --fx-width · --fx-gap: Dot diameter · ring thickness · gap between dots, default 8px · 1px · 10px
options.--fx-on · --fx-off: Filled ring · empty ring colors, default --kf-ink · --kf-line
options.Current point: Child .is-active · .swiper-pagination-bullet-active · [aria-current=true] — attached as-is to the Swiper dots row

note: The original stacks two half panels (::before·::after) over a dot and rotates them in turn to fill the ring. We rebuilt the same shape with conic-gradient and a registered variable (@property --fx-ring) — the center is cleared with mask so only the ring shows on any background.
